card.name: Linking words before 'other' emergency measures
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, the) or an all-caps 'OTHER' right after a named item, just before a continuing list or title, mostly in all-caps warning text.

modes.label: Warning text linking
modes.description: 'AND' or 'OTHER' after epinephrine or oxygen, leading into other emergency or resuscitative measures.
modes.example: SERIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE EPINEPHRINE<< AND>> OTHER EMERGENCY MEASURES.

modes.label: Historical title phrases
modes.description: 'of' or 'the' in old chronicle text after a name or before a title such as President.
modes.example: Fast-day, by proclamation of<< the>> Pres ident

card.plain: It fires on small joining words that come right before the next item in a list or a title, especially in capitalized warnings.
